nodes.summary: Two cells $x$ and $y$ of the $3 \times n$ rectangle are adjacent when they share an edge: they lie in the same row and their columns differ by $1$, or they lie in the same column and their rows differ by $1$.
nodes.title: Adjacent cells

nodes.summary: For $n \ge 1$, let $V_n$ be the number of vertical-fault-free tilings of the $3 \times n$ rectangle by unit squares and dominoes. Then $V_1 = 3$, $V_2 = 13$, $V_3 = 26$, $V_4 = 66$, $V_5 = 154$, $V_6 = 380$, and $V_n = V_{n-1} + 4 V_{n-2} - V_{n-3} - V_{n-4}$ for every $n \ge 7$.
nodes.title: Recurrence for vertical-fault-free tilings of the $3 \times n$ rectangle

nodes.summary: A square-and-domino tiling of the $3 \times n$ rectangle is a finite family $T$ of sets of cells such that every member of $T$ is a square-or-domino tile (a single cell or two adjacent cells), any two distinct members of $T$ are disjoint, and every cell of the rectangle lies in some member of $T$.
nodes.title: Square-and-domino tilings

nodes.summary: A set $d$ of cells of the $3 \times n$ rectangle is a square-or-domino tile if and only if either $d = \{x\}$ for some cell $x$, or $d = \{x, y\}$ for some distinct adjacent cells $x$ and $y$.
nodes.title: Characterization of square and domino tiles

nodes.summary: A set $d$ of cells of the $3 \times n$ rectangle is a square-or-domino tile when it consists of exactly one cell, or of exactly two cells that are adjacent.
nodes.title: Square and domino tiles

nodes.summary: A family $T$ of sets of cells of the $3 \times n$ rectangle, with columns numbered $0, \dots, n-1$, is vertical-fault-free when for every natural number $k$ with $k + 1 < n$ some member of $T$ contains two cells of the same row lying in columns $k$ and $k + 1$. For a square-and-domino tiling this says that every internal vertical boundary is crossed by a horizontal domino.
nodes.title: Vertical-fault-free families

nodes.summary: A cell of the $3 \times n$ rectangle is a pair $(r, c)$ of a row $r \in \{0, 1, 2\}$ and a column $c \in \{0, \dots, n-1\}$.
nodes.title: Cells of the $3 \times n$ rectangle
Recurrence sequence for vertical-fault-free $3 \times n$ tilings

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, this is the number of square-and-domino tilings of the $3 \times n$ rectangle that are vertical-fault-free.
nodes.title: Number of vertical-fault-free tilings of the $3 \times n$ rectangle

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
